description:
Returns `OK` with whether the first administrator exists (`setup`), whether password sign-in is on, the warning days for expiring certificates (`cert_warning_days`), the OIDC sign-in button and, while a database move runs, `maintenance`. The sign-in page and the web interface poll it. Both `/api` and `/api/` answer.

Needs: nothing (public)
